cases.description: Vision grader. Requires a real handwritten-math image at the imagePath below (see fixtures/README.md) — the harness base64-encodes it and sends it to a vision model. Checks that grading is grounded in the image and flags unreadable parts instead of guessing.

values.learningContext: De student kan de kettingregel toepassen op samengestelde functies en de tussenstappen tonen.
values.rubric: Puntenverdeling (max 10): correcte kettingregel (4), correcte tussenstappen tonen (3), correct eindantwoord (2), nette notatie (1).
